pages.title: Chapter Overview
pages.text: Register under Star Palace rule or enter the Inverse Star underground while preparing for Void Heaven Palace.$(br2)This chapter contains 6 authored quest lines. The index describes routes and does not replace server progress.

pages.title: Quest Line Index 1/2
pages.text: $(l:quest_story_chapter_3_chaotic_sea#line_star_palace_register)Star Palace Registration$()$(br)$(l:quest_story_chapter_3_chaotic_sea#line_inverse_star_intro)Inverse Star Contact$()$(br)$(l:quest_story_chapter_3_chaotic_sea#line_xutian_window_prepare)Void Heaven Palace Preparation$()$(br)$(l:quest_story_chapter_3_chaotic_sea#line_qianzhu_tower_trial)Thousand Bamboo Mechanism Tower$()$(br)$(l:quest_story_chapter_3_chaotic_sea#line_dayan_clue)Great Development Art Fragments$()

pages.title: Star Palace Registration
pages.text: Star Palace sets the rules of the Chaotic Sea: register before seeking legal passage.

pages.title: Inverse Star Contact
pages.text: Give the correct countersign before speaking, and keep Star Palace agents away.

pages.title: Void Heaven Palace Preparation
pages.text: A completed map only grants entry; there is still only one supreme cauldron.

pages.title: Thousand Bamboo Mechanism Tower
pages.text: Stop the mechanisms, break the control cores, and seize the tower instead of relying on force.

pages.title: Great Development Art Fragments
pages.text: Assemble the inheritance page by page; the complete art is neither sold nor guaranteed.

pages.title: Void Heaven Palace Expedition
pages.text: Preparation is over; unique treasures belong only to those who leave the palace alive.
